name: Mid-level Python/FastAPI backend engineer, Seattle
notes: Relevance grades are a starting judgement, not ground truth. Edit them.
The point of this file is that tuning the scorer becomes measurable:
change a weight, re-run, see whether nDCG moved. Without it, weight
tuning is guesswork that feels like progress.
2 = strong fit: a backend or full-stack build role on a stack this
candidate works in, at roughly the right level.
1 = plausible: still a software engineering role, but the wrong stack,
the wrong level, or too vague to tell.
0 = poor: not a software-building role for this candidate at all --
solutions consulting, data science, field robotics, part-time
